defects.description: Description: 'Tilt the head back and raise ONE hand up into the hair. Let the OTHER hand rest on the raised knee.' Only ONE hand should be raised (to hair); the OTHER should rest on the raised LEFT knee (leftKnee y=0.190, raised). But config has BOTH shoulders at -110 (PR-v4 overshoot) → both arms fully overhead (L 132°, R 129°), BOTH wrists at y=1.14 above head. Both hands above head instead of one-at-hair + one-on-knee.
Description: 'raise one hand up into the hair' — wrist should be within 0.25 of head. Currently Rw_head=0.673 (and Lw_head=0.665) — both far.
Description: 'other hand rest on the raised knee' — wrist should be within 0.30 of raised LEFT knee (leftKnee at y=0.190). Currently Lw_Lknee=1.238 (and Rw_Rknee=1.586) — both far.

failing_tests.actual: Rw_head=0.673 (right wrist chosen for hair contact — should be raised)
Lw_Lknee=1.238 (left wrist should rest on raised left knee)

regression_risk: medium — 6-field change. Both contacts improved but neither under strict 0.25/0.30 threshold due to rig constraint (elbow flexion geometry). Anomalies 3→2 (cleared one knee_above_hip, retained elbow_above_shoulder R 'may be intended if arms overhead'). Plausibility 2→2 (shoulder flexion values still out of band — measurement convention artifact).
rationale: PR-v4 overshoot fix + asymmetric hand placement. RIGHT hand to hair: rightShoulder -110→-90 (overhead, abduction ~90°), rightElbow 81→140 (deeply bent so forearm returns to head), shoulderFwdR 20→-40 (forward per corrected convention: - = FORWARD, brings elbow forward so wrist arrives at head — Rw_head 0.673→0.306, partial fix due to rig constraint: elbow flexion is rotY around vertical axis, preserves wrist y, so wrist y is bound to elbow y bound to shoulder y; can't get under strict 0.25 threshold without distorting the silhouette). LEFT hand on raised knee: leftShoulder -110→-30 (arm down/forward), leftElbow 100→110 (slightly more bent), shoulderFwdL 20→-60 (forward, brings wrist to knee in front of body — Lw_Lknee 1.238→0.277, partial fix). Lw_y 1.144→0.261 (left wrist at hip/knee level ✓). Rw_y 1.142→0.937 (right wrist above head y=0.802, near hair ✓). HEAD TILT-BACK already achieved (head_pitch -27.7° backward, from existing spine:-12 + globalTilt:-18) ✓. RAISED KNEE already correct (leftKnee y=0.190, leftFoot y=0.600) ✓.
